an5.235:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu gihiṃ anukampati
an5.235:1.7: mahā kho pana bhikkhusaṃgho abhikkanto nānāverajjakā bhikkhū gihīnaṃ upasaṅkamitvā āroceti
an5.235:1.8: mahā kho āvuso bhikkhusaṃgho abhikkanto nānāverajjakā bhikkhū karotha puññāni samayo puññāni kātunti
an5.235:1.9: yaṃ kho panassa bhojanaṃ denti lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā taṃ attanā paribhuñjati saddhādeyyaṃ na vinipāteti
an5.235:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu gihiṃ anukampatīti.
